fuzzing.name: echidna
fuzzing.install: mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin; AUTH_HDR=""; if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then AUTH_HDR="Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN"; fi; TAG=$(curl -s -H "$AUTH_HDR" https://api.github.com/repos/crytic/echidna/releases/latest|grep tag_name|cut -d'"' -f4); VER=${TAG#v}; curl -fsSL https://github.com/crytic/echidna/releases/download/${TAG}/echidna-${VER}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz | tar xz -C $HOME/.local/bin

fuzzing.name: foundry
fuzzing.install: mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin; AUTH_HDR=""; if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then AUTH_HDR="Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN"; fi; TAG=$(curl -s -H "$AUTH_HDR" https://api.github.com/repos/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/latest|grep tag_name|cut -d'"' -f4); curl -fsSL https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/${TAG}/foundry_${TAG}_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C $HOME/.local/bin
fuzzing.purpose: Forge fuzz + invariant testing, Anvil mainnet-fork PoC.
